capability.summary: Run pygount JSON source-line analysis on one path
capability.description: Invokes the pygount CLI with a fixed JSON output format for one supplied path and returns the parsed CLI payload, or a short stderr object when stdout is empty.
capability.problem_space: File-backed source line and language metrics as emitted by pygount's built-in JSON report.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one path argument passed to pygount; output: JSON result containing parsed pygount JSON or an object with up to 200 stderr characters when stdout is empty.
accepted_inputs: a file, directory, or path pattern accepted by the installed pygount CLI
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pygount_sloc", and result as either pygount's parsed JSON report or, when stdout is empty, an object whose stderr string is truncated to 200 characters. A caught subprocess launch, timeout, or nonempty-stdout JSON-decoding exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pygount_sloc", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: depends on an installed pygount executable and enforces a fixed 60-second subprocess timeout
passes only --format=json and exposes no encoding, suffix, duplicate, generated-code, or counting configuration
does not inspect the subprocess return code, so an empty-stdout CLI failure is still wrapped as success with at most 200 stderr characters
nonempty stdout that is not valid JSON triggers the wrapper's error envelope
does not normalize or summarize pygount's version-dependent JSON schema

output_contract.description: Raw parsed pygount JSON report, or a truncated stderr object when pygount emits no stdout.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: compute cyclomatic complexity or maintainability scores
